remarks: Welcome to a truly exceptional private estate encompassing 74 acres of scenic countryside just minutes from Chautauqua Lake and the world-renowned Chautauqua Institution. Tucked away on a private road, this remarkable property offers a rare combination of privacy, luxury, recreation, and versatility. Built in 2015, the custom-designed residence offers approximately 4,700 square feet of living space with 5 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and 2 half baths. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features spacious gathering areas, abundant natural light, and breathtaking unobstructed 360-degree views of the surrounding countryside. Step outside and discover your own private retreat. Enjoy warm summer days in the heated pool, unwind in the hot tub, or take in the peaceful beauty of the property's stocked pond. Rolling fields, wooded hillsides, and open skies create a stunning backdrop, while spectacular sunrises and sunsets can be enjoyed from nearly every direction. A standout feature is the impressive 40' x 120' metal-sided barn with concrete floors, approximately 16-foot ceilings, electric service, and water hookups already in place. Ideal for storage, livestock, equipment, hobbies, or recreational use, this versatile structure offers exceptional flexibility. The acreage presents a diverse landscape of open meadows and wooded terrain with trails, abundant wildlife, and endless opportunities for outdoor recreation. A charming cabin provides additional space for guests or recreational enjoyment. Conveniently located near Chautauqua Lake, local marinas, golf courses, restaurants, and the  cultural attractions of Chautauqua Institution, this extraordinary property offers a rare opportunity to own a substantial acreage estate in one of Western New York's most desirable destinations. Whether your vision includes a private retreat, hobby farm, recreational property, or year-round residence, this remarkable estate offers the space, setting, and amenities to bring it to life.
